recentItems.title: Ciara Is Pregnant With Baby No. 5, Her 4th With Russell Wilson | E! News
recentItems.description:
Ciara revealed that she's expecting her fifth baby, her fourth with Russell. Ciara—who shares kids Sienna Princess, 9, Win Harrison, 6, and Amora Princess, 2, with Russell, as well as son Future Zahir, 12, from her previous relationship with rapper Future—debuted her growing baby bump on Instagram Sept. 6, captioning her announcement, "One more person to Love." The multi-slide post included photos and videos of Russell and Ciara posing outside with four shirts, adorned with the names Future, Sienna, Win and Amora, hanging on a clothesline. A fifth item, a baby onesie, was left blank as the family decides on a name for their bundle of joy. recentItems.title: Elizabeth Smart Turns Heads While Competing in Bodybuilding Show | E! News
recentItems.description:
Nearly five months after Elizabeth Smart revealed she’s now a bodybuilder, Smart shared the results of her latest competitive event. “Another show for the books,” she captioned her Sept. 5 Instagram video of herself posing onstage while sporting a blue bikini. “Had such a blast. I’ve always said, ‘just stepping on stage is a win for me!’ And I completely stand by that.” The 38-year-old—who has been an advocate for trauma survivors after her 2002 kidnapping and months-long disappearance—went on to share the results of her recent show. “I competed in two classes: ‘Masters 35+,’ which requires you to be 35 or older, and ‘Open Class D,’ which is height-based,” she explained. “I placed at the bottom of both classes.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/videos/2513307715731/elizabeth-smart-turns-heads-while-competing-in-milestone-bodybuilding-show

recentItems.title: Kelly Osbourne Details Weight Loss After Dad Ozzy Osbourne's Death | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kelly Osbourne admitted that she didn't realize how much weight she’d lost after her father Ozzy Osbourne's 2025 death: "I looked like the f--king Crypt Keeper." In an interview published Sept. 5, the 41-year-old said grief after the Black Sabbath frontman died from a heart attack at age 76 affected her ability to eat, leaving her unable to see the physical changes that worried friends and family. Kelly recalled wearing a wig to conceal her cheekbones at the 2026 Grammys, where she joined mom Sharon Osbourne and brother Jack Osbourne to honor Ozzy’s legacy, but said she now has the help she needs as she processes her grief and plans a documentary series about mental health. recentItems.title: Kendall Jenner Supports Blake Griffin During Apparent Wedding Weekend | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kendall Jenner—who dated Blake Griffin from 2017 to 2018—stepped out at what appeared to be the retired basketball player’s wedding weekend with his bride-to-be Francesca Aiello in Porto Ercole, Italy, Sept. 5, according to photos obtained by TMZ. In one snap, the Frankies Bikinis founder—donning a white bathing suit—can be seen wrapping her arms around the athlete’s neck as their friends mingle around them. Meanwhile, Griffin—sporting red swimming trunks and a matching hat—looks past his fiancée as the pair wear matching sunglasses. And Jenner, 30, was also keeping up with the festivities as she was seen towards the back of the crowd wearing a pink babydoll dress over her black string bikini and matching flip flops. recentItems.title: I Dream of Jeannie's Barbara Eden Pulls Out of Appearance Amid Illness | E! News
recentItems.description:
I Dream of Jeannie star Barbara Eden, 95, had to cancel her appearance at the Cinecon Classic Film Festival in Los Angeles Sept. 5 after falling ill, the event organizers announced. In a Facebook statement, organizers said Eden was “deeply regretful” to miss the event, where she was slated to receive the Cinecon Legacy Award. Eden’s All Hands on Deck and The Yellow Canary co star Pat Boone accepted the honor on her behalf. The actress, whose career has spanned more than 70 years, recently told Entertainment Weekly she still had no plans to slow down, admitting: “If it’s well written, I’d probably do anything.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/videos/2513304131757/i-dream-of-jeannies-barbara-eden-pulls-out-of-appearance-due-to-sudden-illness

recentItems.title: Kim Kardashian, Kanye West Support North West at First Headlining Show | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kim Kardashian and Kanye West each stepped out to cheer on their daughter North West as she performed at her first headline concert at The Vic Theatre in Chicago, Illinois, Sept. 5. In footage shared online, Kim and Kanye—who also share kids Saint West, 10, Chicago West, 8, and Psalm West, 7—could be seen arriving separately to the event, with The Kardashians star donning a slicked back ponytail as she took her seat in the VIP section. Meanwhile, Kanye arrived later donning a brown bomber jacket and sunglasses as he filmed his daughter onstage. Kim, for her part, shared her own memories from the unforgettable evening. In one video shared to Instagram Stories, Kim captured the screaming crowd waving at her from her perched section. recentItems.description:
